title: every decision, pattern and why lives in one store every agent asks

criteria.text: Every live ruling is a decision record with date, words, concern, departments and tags, and the store exports `constraints/code.md` identical to the hand-built one
criteria.note: Import built (#1222, `scripts/knowledge/import.ts`, `export.ts`); kept in step since by #1411 (constraints header), #1424, #1446 (bug #1445: retires rulings whose replaces tag quotes a dated or re-dated line), #1448, #1483; a daily dry-run import now runs (#1464) [V]. Checked: only `[guards F125.1 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-import.test.ts`, so no. Reviewed: #1222, #1411 and #1446 say 'Reviewed by: none', so no.

criteria.text: Nothing is deleted: the store refuses to retire a decision without a link to the newer one, no change rewrites a record in place, every change writes a history row naming person and agent
criteria.note: Retire-needs-link, history triggers and append-only versions in #1221 (`20261110120000_knowledge_store.sql`); a `retire` lookup verb calling the same function added in #1371 [V] (counted as exposing, not building, the criterion [A]). Checked: three `[guards F125.2 partial]` blocks in `supabase/tests/knowledge_store.sql`, no whole marker, so no standing guard.

criteria.text: The store refuses a philosophy, pattern, decision or correction without a why
History in one call: every version and the chain of older and newer decisions; what was live for a concern on a date
criteria.note: Built in #1221 and the lookup tool #1226 [V]. Checked: `[guards F125.4]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_store.sql` and `tests/knowledge-lookup.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Every record has a kind (philosophy, pattern, decision, correction, ...) and a strength (absolute, rule, guideline)
criteria.note: Lookup tables in #1221 [V]. Checked: `[guards F125.5]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_store.sql`.

criteria.text: Model-neutral: no record names an agent or model as its audience; the model a correction was seen in is only evidence
criteria.note: Built in #1221, import #1222 [V]. Checked: `[guards F125.6]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_store.sql`. Reviewed: #1222 says 'Reviewed by: none', so no.

criteria.text: Settled stays settled: a settled record cannot be proposed for change; the attempt is refused and logged
criteria.note: `refusals` and the refusal in #1221 [V]. Checked: `[guards F125.7]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_store.sql`.

criteria.text: Departments wall off: a department key cannot read another department's internal records; the store login reaches nothing outside its schema and no more than the public key (stage 1)
criteria.note: Wall built in #1221 (PM picked A for stage 1, [for now]) [V]. Checked: six `[guards F125.8 partial]` blocks in `supabase/tests/knowledge_store.sql`, no whole marker, so no.

criteria.text: One concern, one call: moderation live decisions under 2,000 tokens
criteria.note: `live('moderation-and-reports')` measured 1,822 tokens in #1411, which raised the test's margin to 1,900; still under 2,000 but growing; #1286 (open) is the scaling fix [V]. Checked: `[guards F125.9]` in `tests/knowledge-lookup.test.ts`. Reviewed: #1285 says 'Reviewed by: none', so no.

criteria.text: Precedent: one call lists every live decision applying a pattern, with departures; inferred links marked
The platform's why can be read as it stood on any past date, each change naming its evidence
Unanswered questions are kept: every search that finds nothing is logged
Git keeps a copy: a nightly export writes the store to the plan repo by PR, and `constraints/code.md` is generated from it after a week side by side
criteria.note: Not built [V]: `knowledge-import.yml` now runs daily at 13:20 UTC, but only as a dry run of the import (#1464); no workflow writes the store's export to socialus-plan or opens a PR. #1220 (open) is this criterion; open bug #1224 is tagged to it.

criteria.text: The stress tests in the brief run as the store's test suite, each seen failing first
criteria.note: Suite in `supabase/tests/knowledge_store.sql`, run by `tests/knowledge-store-db.test.ts`, each guard seen red (#1221 body) [V]. Checked: one `[guards F125.14 partial]`, so no.
